title: A part requested from a vendor reaches the Part Library when it is received
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part number {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SORECV-01) is in no Part Library entry and is not an inventory part.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example the first vendor in Parts → Vendors) exists; it is only picked, not changed.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open, for a ZZAUTOTEST customer.
  • Its line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL special order line") is approved.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  2. Open {Work-order-1}.
  3. In the Parts row of {Line-1} click + Add Part.
  4. In New Part Request type {Part-A} in Part Number.
  5. Pick the offer to add the typed number as a new part (special order), not an existing result.
  6. Set Source to Vendor.
  7. Pick any Category.
  8. Pick {Vendor-A} in Vendor.
  9. Type 10.00 in Cost.
  10. Type 20.00 in Sell Price.
  11. Click Save Part.
  12. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  13. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  14. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  15. Open {Work-order-1}.
  16. Click the Parts tab of {Work-order-1}.
  17. Click Order on the {Part-A} row.
  18. In the top bar click Parts, then click Purchase Orders in the left menu.
  19. Open the purchase order for {Vendor-A} that holds {Part-A}.
  20. Click Receive.
  21. Type an invoice number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-INV-1) and 1 as the received quantity for {Part-A}.
  22. Click the button that saves the receipt (for example Receive).
  23. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  24. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 11: The part request is saved on {Line-1} with {Part-A}.
  • Step 13: No Part Library entry exists yet for {Part-A}: a part request alone does not create one.
  • Step 22: The part is received.
  • Step 24: One entry {Part-A} is now listed: it was created when the requested part was received.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S11-R6, S11-N1, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.2 (Once inactive: not offered), board 7.1 (Part Library), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026), §1 Clarifications Q11. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R6: “A new Part Library entry is created only from a part number in use: creating an inventory part (S7-R7 and S7-R8), a part request when the requested part is received, a delivery receipt, a core charge, returning a special-order part to inventory, returning a core to inventory, the parts CSV import, and the public API.”
  • S11-N1: “No route, on screen or behind it, produces a Part Library entry with no inventory part, part request, delivery receipt, core charge, return or import row behind it. The one exception is the public API (S11-E3).”
  • Tech plan §1 Clarifications (Q11 Part request entry timing): “PRD corrected: entry created when the requested part is received (S11-R6)”
